title: FilterDirect Subscriber Points on the Replacement System Installations Accessory Member Discount
content:
# Filter-subscriber points

## Rule

The filter-subscriber points of the accessory member discount on a Replacement System Installations contract follow the homeowner's FilterDirect Filter Subscriptions subscription:

- where the subscription is in active status and the contract carries a UV germicidal light, a media air cleaner or a steam humidifier, the points are one percentage point for each whole year from the subscription's start date to the date of handling, at most 5;
- where the subscription is in active status and the contract carries none of those air-quality accessories, the points are a flat 2, whatever the subscription's age;
- a homeowner with no subscription in active status receives no filter-subscriber points.

The subscription's status and start date are read from the FilterDirect Filter Subscriptions record; the accessories from the accessory charges on the project ledger.

## Grid

| FilterDirect subscription | Air-quality accessory on the contract (UV germicidal light, media air cleaner or steam humidifier) | Points |
|---|---|---|
| Active | Yes | One per whole year since the start date, at most 5 |
| Active | No | 2 |
| Not active, or no subscription | Any | None |

## Cases (hypothetical subscribers, date of handling 2026-10-05)

- Active since 2023-04-01, contract carries a media air cleaner: 3 whole years — 3 points.
- Active since 2023-10-06, contract carries a steam humidifier: 2 whole years (the third is not complete until 2026-10-06) — 2 points.
- Active since 2018-01-15, contract carries a UV germicidal light: 8 whole years, capped — 5 points.
- Active since 2025-12-01, contract carries a UV germicidal light: no whole year yet — 0 points.
- Active since 2019-05-01, contract carries only a surge protector: 2 points.
- A subscription in any status other than active: no points.
